description: NaMg₃P₃(HO₆)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.74 Å. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.18 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.11 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 54-56°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-59°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.06 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) H-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mg, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Mg, one P, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Mg and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mg, one P, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Mg and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one P atom.
